data.notes: May 2027 is still early in the announcement cycle, but Lisbon already has a confirmed mix of arena Lusophone pop, electronic-adjacent concerts, Cascais festival programming, and a nearby YARD season opener.

events.title: Coala Festival Portugal 2027
events.summary: Coala Festival Portugal returns to Cascais for its 4th edition, with the official site confirming two open-air days across two stages and a Brazil–Portugal–Africa Lusophone focus; lineup is still to be announced.

events.title: YARD Festival 2027
events.summary: YARD’s 2027 season ticket page confirms YARD Festival across May 27, 28, 29 and 30 as the opening music chapter of its 2027 season near Lisbon.

events.title: Calema — Raízes 360 Tour
events.summary: Calema bring the Raízes 360 Tour to Lisbon’s MEO Arena, with a 360-degree stage format placing António and Fradique at the center of the room.

events.title: Soul Fusion Portugal 2027
events.summary: Seven-night deep and soulful underground house music holiday based in Alvor, with beach parties, pool parties, club events, beach-club sessions and cruise parties across the Algarve coast near Portimão.

events.title: RY X — DUSK Tour
events.summary: RY X returns to Portugal to present DUSK alongside material from across his catalogue, with the Coliseu listing highlighting his electronic and cross-disciplinary approach to performance.

events.title: Rodrigo y Gabriela — OurHome Tour
events.summary: The Grammy-winning Mexican guitar duo Rodrigo y Gabriela return to Portugal for a Lisbon date at Cineteatro Capitólio, presenting the OurHome world tour.

events.title: The Block Party Weekender 2027
events.summary: UK-rooted Block Party brand’s first Portugal weekender, with four days of themed parties, poolside events, beach parties and boat-party programming; listed genres include Afrobeats, Dancehall, Soca, Amapiano, Afro House, Baile Funk, Garage, Funky House, Hip-Hop and R&B.

events.title: The Interrupters @ Lisboa 2027
events.summary: Los Angeles ska-punk band The Interrupters return to Lisbon for a confirmed LAV show promoted by LX Droogs after their 2024 Portugal debut.

events.title: Takeoff Weekender - Albufeira 2027
events.summary: Four-day Algarve diaspora weekender with beach parties, pool parties, themed events, brunches and club nights; the stated music policy covers R&B, hip-hop, dancehall, soca, Afrobeats, Amapiano, house and funky sounds.

events.title: Original Enigma Voices
events.summary: Original Enigma Voices brings a live production built around the musical universe of Enigma to Coliseu dos Recreios, combining music, lighting, dance and immersive staging.

events.title: PANTUÃ | Mariana Dionísio
events.summary: Mariana Dionísio leads PANTUÃ, a voice-and-percussion quintet at CCB described as moving between hypnosis, ecstasy and celebratory ritual.
